summary: Use ProxyCommand, not delegate_to, for bastion hosts over CLI: set ansible_paramiko_proxy_command in inventory or ANSIBLE_PARAMIKO_PROXY_COMMAND. The paramiko variable is deprecated in favour of ansible_libssh_proxy_command.
questions: How do I connect to network devices through a bastion host?
Should I use delegate_to or ProxyCommand for network jump hosts?

answer_card.title: Use ProxyCommand for network jump hosts
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[nxos:vars]
ansible_paramiko_proxy_command='-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
Or for all hosts:
```shell
export ANSIBLE_PARAMIKO_PROXY_COMMAND='-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
No playbook changes needed. Note: `ansible_paramiko_proxy_command` is deprecated with the paramiko plugin; use `ansible_libssh_proxy_command` with libssh.
